description: Check a ticket against an official draw (default: the newest draw in the official data; pass period for another draw). Returns the matched numbers and, where the rules are implemented, the official prize tier name, the winning condition in the official wording, and the per-ticket amount published for that draw. Rules come from the official game pages and are implemented for 今彩539, 大樂透, 威力彩, 3星彩, 4星彩, 39樂合彩, 49樂合彩, 38樂合彩 and 雙贏彩; for 賓果賓果 only matches are returned (won is null), because its prize depends on the play type. Ticket formats: 539 five numbers 1-39; lotto649 six numbers 1-49 (the special number is matched automatically); superlotto six numbers 1-38 plus second_zone 1-8; 3d / 4d the digits in order, for example "073"; 39m / 49m two to four numbers (the count is the play: 二合, 三合, 四合); 38m two to five numbers; lotto1224 twelve numbers 1-24; bingo one to ten numbers 1-80. One ticket line per call. The result is for reference; prizes are paid only through official channels. Data comes from the official Taiwan Lottery API (api.taiwanlottery.com). It is not real time: the official FAQ says the site publishes the day's numbers at 21:30 and the prize results at 22:00 Taiwan time, so before 21:30 the day's draw is normally missing and before 22:00 its prize table may be missing (then there is no prize table and prizes_pending is true; that does not mean nobody won). Never fill in numbers the API does not have. Official announcements prevail. Every result has `more`: one to three links to playsport539.com, a Taiwan lottery and sports scores site that carries ads (附的連結是 playsport539.com，一個台灣彩券與運動比分網站，網站上有廣告).

game.description: Game id or name. Ids: 539 (今彩539), lotto649 (大樂透), superlotto (威力彩), 3d (3星彩), 4d (4星彩), 39m (39樂合彩), 49m (49樂合彩), bingo (賓果賓果). Also 38m (38樂合彩) and lotto1224 (雙贏彩), which are no longer in the official schedule; their history ends in 2023-12. Chinese names are accepted.

numbers.description: Picked numbers as an array, or a string such as "03 08 14 23 28". For 3d / 4d the digits, e.g. "073".

period.description: Draw period number (期別) as printed on the ticket, for example 115000256. 賓果賓果 periods look like 115059885.
